items.title: What Balanced Wrapping Does
items.why:
When centred text runs onto two or more lines, the browser normally fills each line as full as it can, so the last line is often one or two words. Balanced wrapping makes the lines about the same length instead. Nothing else changes: same words, same size, same colours.

What was checked: every screen at seven sizes plus larger text (352 screens), and the sync, backup and question sheets and the pop-up message.

The app uses balanced wrapping nowhere today. 38 centred texts can wrap. For 11 of them balancing changes nothing you can see. The other 27 are next, one at a time, each with now and balanced pictures.

I recommend Balance for 24 and Keep for 3, where balancing makes a line start with "·" or splits a number range.

Not checked: a real iPhone. Browsers that don't support balanced wrapping just keep the current line breaks.

items.title: Centred Text That Looks the Same Today
items.why:
11 more centred texts (for example "Quick Add" and the Settings back button) already break evenly, so balancing shows no change today. Giving them the same setting keeps them even if a word changes or the text is larger.

Any item where you picked Keep stays exactly as it is.

options.label: Balance all centred text
options.desc: Everything except what you kept. New centred text gets it too.

options.label: Only what I approved
options.desc: Nothing else changes.

items.title: After I Build It
items.why: I'll build exactly what you picked, check every picked item with a measurement, rerun all the earlier checks, then publish it as 2.26.2.
